# HBS Online

> > Harvard Business School's flexible online learning platform offering certificate programs and professional credentials taught through the case method.

HBS Online provides business education through certificate and credential programs designed for working professionals seeking career advancement and skill development. The platform covers core business disciplines including leadership, strategy, finance, marketing, and emerging areas like digital transformation and AI.

## Key Topics

- Certificate Programs
- Case Method
- Leadership Development
- Digital Transformation
- Generative AI
- Machine Learning
- Data Science
- Professional Credentials
- Online Learning
- Career Advancement
- Business Strategy
- Finance & Accounting
- Entrepreneurship
- CLIMB Specialization
- Corporate Training

## Core Programs & Certificates

- [Business Essentials](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/business-essentials): HBS Online Business Essentials certificate program covering data analysis and finance
- [Leadership & Management](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/leadership-management): HBS Online Leadership & Management certificates including CLIMB specialization tracks
- [Strategy](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/strategy): HBS Online Strategy certificates covering financial principles and business performance
- [Finance & Accounting](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/finance-accounting): HBS Online Finance & Accounting certificates including Leading with Finance program
- [Marketing](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/marketing): HBS Online Marketing certificates covering data-driven strategies and brand positioning
- [Entrepreneurship & Innovation](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/entrepreneurship-innovation): HBS Online Entrepreneurship & Innovation certificate programs for venture development
- [Digital Transformation & AI](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/digital-transformation-ai): HBS Online Digital Transformation & AI certificates for competitive digital economy skills
- [Business in Society](https://online.hbs.edu/subjects/business-in-society): HBS Online Business in Society certificate program aligning purpose with profit

## Featured Courses

- [Data Science and AI for Decision Making](https://online.hbs.edu/courses/data-science-ai-decision-making): HBS Online course covering machine learning, LLMs, and generative AI for business decisions
- [Strategic Financial Analysis](https://online.hbs.edu/courses/strategic-financial-analysis): HBS Online course on financial analysis, business valuation, and strategic investment decisions
- [Entrepreneurial Marketing](https://online.hbs.edu/courses/entrepreneurial-marketing): HBS Online course developing entrepreneurial mindset and go-to-market strategies for startups
- [Dynamic Teaming](https://online.hbs.edu/courses/dynamic-teaming): HBS Online course building agile teams and leadership in rapidly changing environments
- [Transforming Customer Experiences](https://online.hbs.edu/courses/transforming-customer-experiences): HBS Online course on delivering competitive customer experiences and service excellence
